name: Murata (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Murata town emblem in white: a stylised bird with outstretched wings above a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Murata, a town in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 16 May 1961.

features.role: Murata town emblem — a stylised bird with outstretched wings above a ring
